requiredFindings.title: Define the early refusal needed for the no-matching-kind pre-bound
requiredFindings.description: The general resolution procedure follows symlink rows before checking the final requested kind, but the no-rows special case asserts that only one lookup can occur and budgets only that lookup. A valid flat tree can contain file f and symlink l targeting f, with no dir rows. Directory("l") follows l, allocates the one-byte joined path f, looks up f, and then refuses Association for its type. For the retained order [f,l], the existing binary search makes one comparison for l and two for f. That failure prefix costs three edges plus one object/one byte, while the stated no-dir-row pre-bound has at most two edges and zero objects/bytes. No explicit early kind-absence rule currently prevents that execution. CI-T28 specifically requires the bound relation for this case.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Normatively require refusal before following a symlink or allocating its joined path when the requested kind has no rows (with at most the priced initial lookup), or fund the complete possible failed-resolution prefix. Make the refusal-prefix accounting explicit where there is no resolved member m. Add the file-plus-link/no-dir Directory("l") case to CI-T28 and verify actual charges against the pre-bound.

requiredFindings.title: Preserve the capability latch for Budget failures too
requiredFindings.description: The interaction text excludes Budget from launch_member's capability latch because the ledger latches itself, then concludes that no later launch or transfer of the capability proceeds. These are different lifetimes. The accepted CI-2-r2 transfer explicitly stores Latched::Budget in the capability; later calls return Budget(Closed) before charging even if passed another scope. The proposed launch API also accepts a caller-supplied WorkScope on every call and does not bind the capability to one ledger. A launch exhausted on ledger A therefore need not stop a later transfer/launch on fresh ledger B under the proposed exception. This contradicts both the claimed extension of the existing latch and CI-T27's unconditional cross-operation latching rule.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Latch Budget on the capability as transfer already does, and specify the later Budget(Closed) result consistently, rather than relying only on the exhausted ledger. Add a failed-launch Budget control followed by launch and transfer using a fresh funded scope, requiring no additional charge or observation. If a different lifetime policy is intended, explicitly amend the invariant and enforce a capability-to-ledger association; do not assert it follows from a ledger latch alone.

rulings.Q1: The new separation of exact executed comparisons/read attempts from their envelopes is accepted in principle and resolves CIA3-R2-RF-2's equality problem: E uses s_j and a, B uses their bounds, and neither unused comparisons nor extra reads are executed. Empty files have one EOF attempt. The maxima, checked arithmetic and Directory("") special case are defined. Full E≤B≤Bhat acceptance is withheld pending CIA3-R3-RF-1: a no-matching-kind failure can follow a symlink and exceed its single-lookup pre-bound unless the early refusal is made an explicit operation rule. Refusal prefixes also need an explicit interpretation when no member m resolves.
rulings.Q2: Accepted. All six members rehash exactly. The CI-A2 context copy is byte-equal to the SCOPE.md pin inside the exact CI-2-r2 subject manifest and to the corresponding packaged scope. The amendment adopts that revised context rather than reconstructing the obsolete live-file pin. CI-A2-b supplies the retained component index and CI-A2-c the at-most ceil(log2 n)+1 search comparisons charged individually, matching CI-A3. The archived copy removes dependence on future edits to the CI fork's working scope; the old r2 manifest need not be repaired as history.
rulings.Q3: Accepted for the spelling and reservation terms: the native basename uses CI-A2-h's fixed stack buffer without an owned-record charge; the single heap launch-path buffer remains P+1 and is borrowed as CStr for lstat and reused in the result; the store path remains a separate one-time L-byte opening charge. CI-A2-e's full installer reservation does not change per-operation launch charging. The latch extension is not accepted as written because of CIA3-R3-RF-2: excluding Budget loses the accepted capability-level poison when a later call supplies another ledger.
